description: Divisional Secretariat - The Annual Perahera Festival of Uggal Aluthnuwara Katharagama Devalaya - 2020 - The Annual Perahera Feshtival of Bolthube Saman Devalaya - 2020
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the organization and regulation of religious/cultural festivals (the Annual Perahera Festival of Uggal Aluthnuwara Katharagama Devalaya and Bolthube Saman Devalaya). It details event schedules, camp areas, health and safety regulations, traffic control, and administrative arrangements for the festivals. This content does not involve government structural/personnel changes (Types 1-3) and does not fit any of the specialized administrative categories (Types 4-9) as it is not about land, legal, commercial, electoral, public service, or judicial matters. It falls under cultural/administrative matters not covered by other categories.
